post.description: Mint a new API key. The full key is returned once here and never again.

delete.description: Revoke (delete) an API key. It stops working immediately.

post.description: Create or update the single account's password (optionally enabling the auth gate).
Toggle auth_enabled / kiosk_public (enabling auth without an account is refused).

delete.description: Remove the web UI logo and return the navbar to the default mark.

post.description: Upload the web UI (navbar) logo. PNG, JPG or GIF, max 2 MB.

Put the player on standby with the saved ident, to see it. Refused while
a programme or a manual queue is loaded, since standby would end it.
Check the ticket printer without printing (file: path writable; network: short TCP connect); blanks fall back to saved settings.
Verify a TMDB API key with a cheap authenticated call (blank = the saved one; invalid is ok=false, not an error).
Test an un-saved connection and list its libraries (for the Add/Edit form).

get.description: The library's ONE source, or null before one is configured.

post.description: Re-run one check by key (the topbar health menu's "Check again").

get.description: Stream a ticket-library image, for the image library's thumbnails (the library isn't web-served).

post.description: Reprint an issued ticket exactly as it was; records nothing new.
Recover a printer left in a bad state (ESC @ + feed) instead of a power-cycle.

get.description: Server-rendered PNG thumbnail of a template; with programme_id, against that programme's real features.
The active trailer job (or most recent), with full log — used on page load.

post.description: Delete multiple trailers; missing IDs and un-removable files are reported back, not fatal.
Attach one tag to many trailers; missing IDs are reported back.
Rename trailers to the configured naming template; returns the plan (dry_run) or result counts.

get.description: Dry-run a trailer rule's matching; flags the top `count` candidates that would play.

post.description: Create a trailer tag; case-insensitively idempotent (an existing name is returned).

get.description: Thin TMDB movie-search proxy; without a key returns an empty result list, never an error.
List a movie's YouTube videos from TMDB, trailers first (official before fan uploads, newest first).

tags.description: Comma-separated trailer tag names (created if new)
tags.title: Tags

tmdbid.description: Optional TMDB id to link — fills metadata automatically
